# MasaPay

> QR menu and ordering platform for restaurants and cafés in Bulgaria. Guests scan a QR code at the table, browse the menu, order, leave a tip and pay from their phone — no app, no waiter. Built in Sofia for the Bulgarian hospitality market.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.masapay.eu/): What MasaPay is, three-step flow, feature grid, pricing tiers.
- [Features](https://www.masapay.eu/features): QR menu, 6-language translation, real-time analytics, tipping, cash-register integration, Bulgarian-language support.
- [How it works](https://www.masapay.eu/how-it-works): Three steps — scan, order, pay — from the guest's and the operator's perspective.
- [Pricing](https://www.masapay.eu/pricing): Three EUR tiers (Кафе €30/mo, Ресторант €75/mo, Верига custom). First month free. No cut of sales.
- [Demo menus](https://www.masapay.eu/demo): Live preview menus (brunch, cocktail bar, Bulgarian tavern).
- [About](https://www.masapay.eu/about): Team, founding story, values.
- [Contact](https://www.masapay.eu/contact): Sales and support — Sofia, +359 88 520 2277.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://www.masapay.eu/privacy)

## Quick facts

- Currency: EUR (€).
- Primary language: Bulgarian; in-product menus support BG, EN, DE, FR, IT, RU.
- Target market: Sofia / Bulgaria restaurants, cafés, bars.
- POS integrations: Datecs, Tremol, Eltrade.
- Payment methods inside the product: Apple Pay, Google Pay, card.
- Contact: WhatsApp +359 88 520 2277 · sales/support 08:00–23:00 EET.
